events.summary: Talasyn 在窗边主动接近阿德尔·扎维耶，用关切的语气问起他女儿，套取消息。
events.quote: “I couldn’t help overhearing a bit of your conversation with my husband. You seemed nervous. I hope everything is all right with your daughter.”

events.summary: 扎维耶放下戒心，说皇帝只是在执行夜皇帝的旨意、保护新式武器，并求皇后替他打听女儿下落。
events.quote: Zawye regarded Talasyn with eager hope. “But perhaps if Her Majesty could prevail upon him to check in on my daughter . . .?”

events.summary: Talasyn 与 Alaric 回到大角城官邸的居住翼，他遣散卫兵，在窗廊里把她抵在墙边亲吻。
events.quote: he crowded her up against the wall, caging her between the windowsill and his big body.

events.summary: Talasyn 想到 Alaric 可能看见她和扎维耶说话而惊慌，决定不再欺瞒、要把真相告诉他。
events.quote: She finally had information to use against him. But she wasn’t going to. She would tell him the truth.

events.summary: Sevraim 闯进廊道报告：Ileis 与 Nisene 在 Shipsbane 峡谷发现叛军基地，要 Alaric 立刻前往。
events.quote: “Your Majesty, we’ve received word from Ileis and Nisene,” he announced. “They found a rebel base. You’re needed there at once.”

events.summary: 次日 Talasyn 在阳台咬指甲自责；Khaede 冷淡地说峡谷里布满陷阱，至少能带走数名影铸者。
events.quote: “Our comrades littered that whole section of the Shipsbane with traps. At the very least, they’ll take several Shadowforged with them.”

events.summary: Talasyn 赶到 Gaheris 塔前与 Ileis、Nisene 对峙等候；Alaric 出来后不停步，抓住她的手臂把她一路拖走。
events.quote: He didn’t stop walking even when he reached Talasyn, instead grabbing her by the arm so that she had no choice but to scramble to keep up

events.summary: Alaric 在小巷里承认怕她不安全，并告知已俘获五十名叛军、次日处决，且 Regent Gaheris 要求她到场。
events.quote: “Talasyn,” he said, “we captured fifty of the rebels. Their execution is slated for tomorrow.”

relations.relation: 夫妻（耐纳瓦雷皇后与凯萨斯的夜皇帝）；她实为萨尔达维亚的双面间谍
relations.quote: “They’ll be sorely disappointed. I’ve grown much too used to the Nenavarene tradition.” He squeezed her hand. Lingering, affectionate.

relations.relation: 君臣（皇后与阿德尔）；她利用他对女儿的牵挂套出军情
relations.quote: If Zawye loved his daughter a little less, it wouldn’t have worked. His guard wouldn’t have been lowered.

relations.relation: 父女；女儿因驻地性质不能写信回家，父母因此不安
relations.quote: But she is my only daughter, so her mother and I confess ourselves anxious.

relations.relation: 旧日挚友，如今分属敌对阵营，形同陌路
relations.quote: she spun around to gaze, stricken, at her first friend—for such a long time her only friend—who was more like a stranger now.

relations.relation: 父子（Regent 与皇帝）；父亲曾把他伤得遍体淤青裂伤，如今仍能命令皇后到场
relations.quote: the bruises and lacerations that his own father had inflicted on him.

numbers.context: Alaric 称此役俘获五十名叛军
numbers.quote: we captured fifty of the rebels. Their execution is slated for tomorrow.

numbers.context: 此役阵亡的凯萨斯军团士兵人数
numbers.quote: “Dozens of legionnaires died during the skirmish,” said Alaric. “It’s the biggest loss Kesath has suffered since the end of the Hurricane Wars.

numbers.context: 五十名俘军的处决时间与地点（平原上）
numbers.quote: “The execution will be carried out on the plains at first light,” Alaric continued tersely.

numbers.context: 官邸走廊尽头并排、同样华丽的卧房门数
numbers.quote: Her gaze flickered to the two doors at the end of the passage, of equal size and splendor.

numbers.context: Khaede 预计陷阱至少能带走的影铸者人数
numbers.quote: At the very least, they’ll take several Shadowforged with them.

numbers.context: Talasyn 与 Alaric 相处、逐渐相熟的时长
numbers.quote: This was not the man she’d come to know over the past year in the quiet moments
